name: copy_test_tile_rows_to_alpha
purpose: Copy sixteen source words into each selected alpha-display row
arguments: start column word; first row word; last row inclusive word; source word pointer

name: read_debounced_input
purpose: Sample and two-frame-debounce one self-test input word; when ram.os_vblank_active is zero it also republishes ram.input_source_ptr from the 0x40042 game hook or the 0x803000 constant at 0x5A46
return: D0.l = stable active-low press edges, with asserted raw high-nibble inputs included

name: load_color_test_palettes
purpose: Load the three 256-word color-test palette banks and initialize the test palette

name: reset_sound_test_interface
purpose: Synchronize to VBLANK, pulse the sound reset/control line, and clear OS sound-test state

name: fill_incrementing_words
purpose: Fill a word buffer with an ascending sequence
arguments: destination word pointer; first word; count long

name: display_standard_large_glyph_range
purpose: Draw an ascending glyph-index range with standard-display large-glyph strides
arguments: alpha destination pointer; first glyph word; count word

name: display_rotated_large_glyph_range
purpose: Draw an ascending glyph-index range with rotated-display large-glyph strides
arguments: alpha destination pointer; first glyph word; count long

name: run_switch_test
purpose: Render and operate the live four-player switch/input diagnostic until the advance input is pressed

name: wait_os_vblank
purpose: Clear the OS VBLANK semaphore and wait until the IRQ4 handler sets it

name: display_next_test_prompt
purpose: Draw the orientation-appropriate 'Press [button] for next test' descriptor chain

name: send_sound_test_command_wait
purpose: Send one diagnostic sound command and wait up to thirty VBLANK ticks for its response
return: D0.l = response byte, or -1 on timeout

name: wait_sound_test_delay_or_abort
purpose: Clear the sound command latch and wait up to four VBLANK ticks for the advance input
return: D0.l = 1 when advance was pressed, otherwise 0 after timeout

name: display_two_byte_hex_pair
purpose: Pack two byte-valued arguments and display them as a four-digit zero-padded hexadecimal field
arguments: high byte; low byte; signed display-offset byte
